text: TODAY | The BFP Special Rescue Unit, now known as the Special Rescue Force (SRF), marks its 28th year of unwavering service to the Filipino people. From the harrowing operations of the Payatas Tragedy to the devastating SuperFerry 14 bombing, the men and women of the SRF have stood on the frontlines of the nation’s most difficult rescue missions. Clad in their iconic orange—now in pixelated form for greater visibility—the team became a symbol of courage, hope, and relentless commitment amid disaster. Today, that same spirit continues as SRF teams respond to earthquakes, floods, fires, and collapsed structures across the country, including deployments to assist communities affected by major disasters such as the recent earthquake response in Cebu.  For 28 years, through danger, darkness, and uncertainty, the Special Rescue Force has remained a constant—ready to climb higher, dig deeper, and go further to save lives. The SRF will always be visible. The SRF will always answer the call.
